tt33764258.title: The Odyssey
tt33764258.description: Christopher Nolan's IMAX-shot adaptation of Homer's epic. Odysseus's perilous journey home after the Trojan War — large-scale mythic action from the master of blockbuster prestige.

tt31378509.title: Dune: Part Three
tt31378509.description: Denis Villeneuve adapts Dune Messiah — Paul's imperial reign, galactic fallout, and new conspiracies years after Part Two. You gave Part One a 9 and Part Two a 10.

tt5875444.title: Slow Horses — Season 6
tt5875444.description: MI5's dumped 'slow horses' under Jackson Lamb return. Season 6 reportedly blends Joe Country and Slough House storylines. You gave the series a 9.

tt38553367.title: The Case
tt38553367.description: From Lupin creator George Kay: a Stockholm summer serial-killer hunt forces investigator Thomas Berg to work with his disgraced father. Jakob Oftebro leads.

tt36408401.title: The Adventures of Cliff Booth
tt36408401.description: David Fincher directs Quentin Tarantino's script. Brad Pitt's stuntman/fixit Cliff Booth years after Once Upon a Time in Hollywood — noir-tinged industry crime.

tt22202452.title: Pluribus — Season 2
tt22202452.description: Vince Gilligan's sci-fi: a lone immune writer resists a hive-mind 'happiness' plague. Breaking Bad-adjacent tone. You gave Season 1 a 10.

tt11280740.title: Severance — Season 3
tt11280740.description: The Lumon conspiracy deepens. Filming from summer 2026. You gave this a perfect 10.

tt32477632.title: Secret Service
tt32477632.description: MI6's Russia desk chief (Gemma Arterton) suspects a top politician may be a Russian asset. Ripped-from-headlines espionage from Tom Bradby.

editorial-the-koreans.title: The Koreans
editorial-the-koreans.description: Korean reimagining of The Americans: North Korean sleeper couple in 1990s South Korea, hunted by counterintelligence. You gave The Americans a 10.

tt26598805.title: Lazarus
tt26598805.description: Lars Kepler's Joona Linna universe: ex-soldier detective, a lethal serial killer, and an FBI agent. Nordic procedural grit with US scope.

tt10577736.title: Tehran — Season 4
tt10577736.description: Mossad undercover missions in Iran continue. Tense tradecraft and geopolitical stakes. You gave the series an 8.

tt11947656.title: Lapland War
tt11947656.description: 1944 Lapland: Finns forced to turn on retreating Germans. Survival, guilt, and reconciliation in Nordic war epic.

tt27995594.title: Black Doves — Season 2
tt27995594.description: Keira Knightley returns as a London spy-wife balancing espionage and domesticity. Season 1 was a Christmas surprise hit — season 2 leans harder into the action.

tt14688458.title: Silo — Season 3
tt14688458.description: Juliette and the underground community face the truth about what lies outside. Adapting the final book in Howey's trilogy.

tt2788316.title: Shogun — Season 2
tt2788316.description: After sweeping the Emmys, FX's feudal Japan epic continues the story of Toranaga's rise. Expected to adapt further Clavell material.

tt9813792.title: From — Season 4
tt9813792.description: The nightmare town continues. Answers about the creatures and the forest promised as the show enters its second half.

tt21092834.title: Verity
tt21092834.description: Colleen Hoover adaptation directed by Michael Showalter. Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson star. A struggling writer discovers horrifying secrets in a bestselling author's manuscript.

editorial-tsunami.title: Tsunami
editorial-tsunami.description: Takashi Yamazaki (Godzilla Minus One) directs a human-scale tsunami disaster film. Period setting, practical effects, same team that won the VFX Oscar.
